newsitem.title: JAPAN: Suzuki launches new recreational vehicle.
newsitem.headline: Suzuki launches new recreational vehicle.

text.p: Suzuki Motor Corp said on Wednesday it has launched a wide-body version of its Wagon R recreational vehicle with new engines in Japan.

Suzuki offers a newly developed 1,000cc aluminium engine and 1,000cc aluminium intercooler turbo-charger engine for the new "Wagon R Wide". The new Wagon R Wide will have a monthly sales target of 2,000 units with a domestic selling price ranging from 758,000 yen to 1.355 million yen.
In January, Suzuki, 3.2 percent owned by General Motors Corp, forecast its domestic sales of compact cars of 75,000 in calendar 1997, up 13 percent from a year earlier.
Sales of the new Wagon R Wide are included in its 1997 overall sales target.
